notes: 2026-08-05: first release. No number is published because none has been measured — React's own test suite is written against JSX, jsdom and a browser scheduler, none of which exist here, so there is no upstream case corpus this port could be diffed against and any percentage would be invented. What is ported: the element model (CreateElement/H/Frag/CloneElement/IsValidElement, Fragment, the Children helpers), function components, the fiber reconciler with keyed matching, the hook set (state, reducer, effect/layout/insertion effects, memo, callback, ref, imperative handle, debug value, id, context, transition, deferred value, optimistic, action state, sync external store), Memo/StrictMode/Profiler, Suspense/ErrorBoundary/Lazy, and server rendering (RenderToString / RenderToStaticMarkup / RenderToWriter / MustRenderToString). What is not: JSX, class components, the DOM renderer and synthetic event system, the concurrent scheduler and lane-based priority, time slicing, streaming/selective hydration, React Server Components, and the DevTools protocol. Intentional differences are itemised in API-DEVIATIONS.md.
